description: 轉運站護理師（nurse）的建置配方：build_character.py 依這份檔案從頭產出角色。每個步驟的輸入輸出見 design/03-art-pipeline/CHARACTER_PIPELINE.md。
name: 轉運站護理師

design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, saturated neon accents. Full body, strict side view facing right, standing upright with the arms relaxed at the sides and empty hands, the far-side leg hidden behind the near leg. a transit station nurse, about seven heads tall, brisk and neat: a pale teal medical uniform with cyan trim, a surgical cap and a face mask pulled under the chin, a small cyan lit tablet clipped at the hip, white shoes. Empty hands.
